description: This is the main entry point script for the resident_backend_api project. It sets up environment variables, optionally injects a local virtual environment's site-packages into sys.path, loads environment variables from a .env file, imports the ASGI app, and starts a Uvicorn server with specified parameters.

methods.name: int _env_int(name: str, default: int)
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable as an integer with a default fallback.

methods.name: str _env_str(name: str, default: str)
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable as a string with a default fallback.

methods.name: None _maybe_inject_venv_site_packages(project_root: Path)
methods.description: Checks if a virtual environment's site-packages directory exists and prepends it to sys.path and PYTHONPATH.

methods.name: None _maybe_load_dotenv(project_root: Path)
methods.description: Attempts to load environment variables from a .env file if python-dotenv is available.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Main function that runs environment setup and starts the Uvicorn server with the app.
